snippet.title: Future Knight - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The neo-retro shooter Future Knight arrives on August 13, 2026! 🚀

Wishlist now on your favorite platform:
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235410/Future_Knight

Take control of a highly unconventional duo: Future Knight himself and "Two More", a benign tumor with a mind of its own. Together, they must fight their way through hordes of enemies in a 2D Shoot 'Em Up adventure that stands out for its direct gameplay, freedom of action, and a strong sense of dark humor.

Developed in co-production by Studio Koba and Aeternum Game Studios. 

📅 Release Date: August 13, 2026
💲 Price: $14.99 / 14.99€
🕹️ Platforms: PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch 

Follow us for more updates:
Twitter / X: https://x.com/aeternathegame

#FutureKnight #IndieGame #ShootEmUp #StudioKoba #AeternumGameStudios
